accepted_checkpoint_33.reason: One continuous lower-flare turn replaces the extra inflection and shading band; the groove is slightly shallower. All heights and the socket shelf/drop remain exact. Material and lighting are unchanged.

rejected_269.reason: Flatter shelf reads too square in neutral side view and loses the rounded reference crescent in the unchanged wood/light rig. Exterior silhouette alone cannot arbitrate this change.

note: Neutral trials have no invented wood/grain/light score. Small wood-vs-neutral IoU differences reflect sampling, not a separate fit.
